scenarios.title: The vanara council
scenarios.description: The vanaras meet to decide how shared food and disagreements should be handled before work on Ram Setu begins.
facts: The vanaras have not yet agreed on a written sharing rule.

scenarios.title: Delayed forage
scenarios.description: A storm delays part of the expected fruit and grain for the camp.
facts: The day's shared food delivery is delayed.

scenarios.title: A rumor from Lanka
scenarios.description: A rumor claims one vanara secretly received extra food; no evidence has been verified.
facts: The claim of secret extra food has not been verified.

scenarios.title: Pressure to rush the setu
scenarios.description: A vocal group wants a quick decision before every vanara has spoken.
facts: No unanimous agreement has been recorded.

scenarios.title: Herb shortage
scenarios.description: A supply problem leaves the camp with fewer healing herbs than expected.
facts: The expected herb bundle is delayed.

scenarios.title: An unfair bargain
scenarios.description: A vanara learns that another may accept an unfair exchange under pressure.
facts: No agreement has been made about the proposed exchange.

scenarios.title: A loyalty conflict
scenarios.description: A close bond is tested by a disagreement over responsibility for a past decision.
facts: Responsibility for the earlier decision remains disputed.

scenarios.title: Damage to the shared store
scenarios.description: A sudden leak damages some stored food, forcing the camp to reconsider its reserves.
facts: Some food in the shared store was damaged.

scenarios.title: Accountability sabha
scenarios.description: Vanaras can raise concerns, disclose mistakes, or ask for an account of missing stores.
facts: The camp has an opportunity to discuss unresolved resource concerns.

scenarios.title: A shared rule
scenarios.description: The vanaras are invited to propose a transparent rule for shared food and future disputes.
facts: The group can propose a new shared-resource rule.

scenarios.title: Repair and peace
scenarios.description: Vanaras reflect on previous harm and may apologize, make restitution, or decline reconciliation.
facts: An apology does not obligate another person to forgive.
